tagline: AI drafts the checks. Evidence verifies the work. Humans approve. PayPal completes the checkout.
short_summary: Prooflane checks freelance CSV deliveries against human-reviewed requirements and the agreed source, blocks incorrect work, and connects the exact approved version to a reconciled PayPal sandbox payment.
functional_demo: Runnable repository; Python 3.11+ only; README and submission/JUDGE_GUIDE.md
ai_role: Gemini drafts constrained acceptance checks from the brief. The server validates them and a person reviews scope. It cannot authorize payment; CSV rows stay local.
paypal_role: Sandbox Orders v2 creation, buyer approval, capture and authenticated readback with exact amount and frozen manifest reference in custom_id.
team_information: Account owner must confirm entrants, team membership, eligibility and representative authority; no extra teammates invented.
submission_confirmation: Entrant confirmed submitting to Devpost on 11 November 2026; public Devpost URL and video visibility not independently verified.
